screening.samplingFinding: Thirty-three of 102 genuinely unseen domains passed the frozen two-query, opposite-viewport machine and original-resolution visual qualification gate and were append-only assigned to the sealed final cohort.
screening.visualValidationFinding: All sixty-six accepted annotation views and their frozen candidate roots were inspected at original resolution. The accepted evidence spans length, area, count, mass, and volume layouts, including explicit and implicit quantities, native unit prices, current and list prices, pack variants, and valid abstention cases. Every accepted page contains at least eight query-relevant atomic product roots without repeated page chrome.
